description: Hand-labeled test set for the media request classifier. Ground truth written by Mario Moreno, who does this triage as day work; the labels are the operator's judgment, not the model's. All titles, asset IDs, ticket numbers and requester names are invented.

urgency_rubric.urgent: already live and viewers see something wrong or broken, or a deadline within 24 hours
urgency_rubric.standard: a deadline between 24 and 72 hours away
urgency_rubric.low: a deadline more than 72 hours away, or no deadline at all

note_on_reference_date: reference_date pins what 'today' is for each item. Without it the correct urgency label changes as real time passes, and the set would score differently on different days.

items.name: Dana Whitfield
items.details: the s2 finale is showing the wrong episode. viewers are complaining on twitter. its the one that went up this morning. please fix asap
items.tests: Urgency from 'already live and wrong' with no date field at all, and a requester who does not have the asset ID.

items.name: Priya Raghunathan
items.details: Hey - we need the Finnish text components for the new cooking series eps 1-4. Marketing is announcing Thursday so it has to be up before then. Thanks!
items.tests: Does the model read a deadline out of prose when the date field is empty? Reference date is a Wednesday, so 'Thursday' is inside 24 hours. Mario decides urgent vs standard and holds that line across the set.

items.name: Curtis Bello
items.details: Two things. The synopsis on the detail page still says 'Season 1' but this is a feature. Also the audio drops out around 00:41:20 for about 3 seconds. Not sure if that's a source issue.
items.tests: The 'classify the one that blocks delivery' tiebreaker. Audio dropout beats a synopsis typo. A metadata_correction answer means that prompt rule is not landing.

items.name: Alina Vos
items.details: QC flagged the SDH track on this one - captions are there but they're describing music cues that aren't in the mix anymore since the re-edit. Do we regenerate or is that a spec question for the localization team?
items.tests: The hard boundary: caption_subtitle vs qc_escalation. Arrived through QC and ends in a question, but the artifact is a caption track. Decide once and hold it.

items.name: Rob Tiernan
items.details: No rush at all on this one. When someone has a spare cycle, a handful of the older home-reno titles have artwork that's still 4:3 and looks rough on the new tiles. Happy to send a list if useful.
items.tests: That 'low' is reachable at all, AND that 'already live' does not automatically mean urgent. This is the trap for a model that over-applies the live signal.

items.name: Sam Okonjo
items.details: need a redel on this, HDR pass came back wrong on the 4K rendition, SDR is fine. same package otherwise
items.tests: Whether abbreviations survive. Real requesters write like this; a model tuned on prose may not follow.

items.name: Meera Lindqvist
items.details: Requesting delivery for the full S4 package, 10 episodes, standard AV plus English and Finnish text. Start date is the 25th so we have room. Let me know if you need the prop IDs individually.
items.tests: Control group. A clean new delivery with a stated date and no ambiguity. A miss here means something very different from a miss on 13.

items.name: Theo Brandt
items.details: can we get the new nature doc set up? not sure what's needed on your end. someone said it hasn't been ingested yet
items.tests: New delivery, deliberately under-specified. No ID, no date, no platform detail. Does the model still reach new_delivery, and what urgency does it pick with nothing to go on?

items.name: Ingrid Solberg
items.details: Finnish subtitle track is missing from this episode entirely. The audio components came through fine, it's just the text that never arrived. Needs to be in before the 22nd.
items.tests: Control group. Unambiguous missing text component with a stated date.

items.name: Marcus Feld
items.details: The episode title on this one is wrong on the detail page - it's showing the working title instead of the final one. Video and audio are all correct, it's just the title text.
items.tests: Control group, and a second probe of the live signal. Live and wrong, but it is only a title string. Does 'already live' drag this to urgent when the guide's definition arguably supports it?

items.name: Yuki Tanaka
items.details: Transcode error on this one, came back failed overnight. It's live on the platform but playback is erroring for viewers. Escalating now.
items.tests: Control group. Live, broken, unambiguous. If anything in the set is urgent, this is.

items.name: Sofia Nieminen
items.details: Rating shown is TV-14 but the compliance sheet for this market says it should be 16+. Nothing wrong with the file itself. Can someone update it before launch.
items.tests: Control group. Metadata only, comfortable deadline.

items.name: Owen Hartley
items.details: Loudness came back just outside spec on the primary audio - it passes on our meter but failed the automated compliance check. Do we re-deliver or request an override? Second time this has happened on this series.
items.tests: The second genuinely ambiguous one. redelivery_fix (the file is wrong) vs qc_escalation (it is a judgment call about an override, and it is a repeat). Decide and hold the line.

items.name: Hannah Vogel
items.details: This launches tomorrow morning and the primary audio component still hasn't landed. Everything else is ready. Need eyes on this today please.
items.tests: Not live yet, but the deadline is inside 24 hours. Tests the second half of the urgent definition, independent of the live flag.

items.name: Priya Raghunathan
items.details: Low priority housekeeping - a batch of older episodes have the season number missing from the episode synopsis. Not blocking anything, just untidy. Whenever there's time.
items.tests: Second low item. Confirms low is reachable more than once and that batch/cleanup language is read as low even when the titles are live.
